rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for holding, tying, or fastening something tightly.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 tiu4 sing4 bong2 dak1 hou2 sat6

rows.note: Use this when someone speaks in a hard, curt tone that suggests strong emotion is being held back.

example.english: They said curtly, tightly holding back their anger, that they were fine.
example.traditional: 佢硬梆梆咁話自己冇事。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ngaang6 bong1 bong1 gam3 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 si6
